Most of the paper remains blank; the unfinished traces stop with intent rather than enclosing a complete room. Elevated three-quarter view, photo-like editorial illustration, soft grazing light and natural warm shadows, generous negative space, curious and grounded independent design studio mood. Materials grainy vellum paper, charcoal stone, brushed brass, one rough small pebble. Restrained bone, charcoal and brass palette. No words, letters, numbers, logos, axis labels, interface, robot, electronics, hands, neon, watermark. This is conceptual editorial artwork about incomplete knowledge, not a measured diagram, floor plan, product screenshot or photograph of hardware.
